name: Todoist
label: Todoist API v1
description: Todoist REST API v1 at https://api.todoist.com/api/v1. Docs: https://developer.todoist.com/rest/v2/#overview. create requires content; due via due_string or due_date/due_datetime. Bearer api_token. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log api_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Todoist official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'create', 'get', 'list', 'update', 'close', 'reopen', 'delete'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'create'.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Task text. Required on create. Used on update. Example: Buy milk.

schema.label: project_id
schema.description: Project id on create and list.

schema.label: due_string
schema.description: Human due string on create / update. Example: tomorrow at 16:00. Mutually exclusive with due_date/due_datetime.

schema.label: priority
schema.description: Priority 1–4 (4 is urgent) on create / update. Default 1.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Task description (markdown) on create / update.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: section_id
schema.description: Section id on create and list.

schema.label: parent_id
schema.description: Parent task id on create (subtask).

schema.label: order
schema.description: Task order among siblings on create.

schema.label: labels
schema.description: Label names on create / update. Example: ["work","today"].

schema.label: assignee_id
schema.description: Responsible user id on create / update (shared projects).

schema.label: due_date
schema.description: Due date YYYY-MM-DD on create / update. Example: 2026-11-01.

schema.label: due_datetime
schema.description: Due RFC3339 datetime on create / update.

schema.label: due_lang
schema.description: Language hint for due_string, e.g. en.

schema.label: duration
schema.description: Duration amount on create / update. Requires duration_unit.

schema.label: duration_unit
schema.description: Duration unit on create / update. minute | day.

schema.label: lang
schema.description: list query lang for filter language.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: create, get, list, update, close, reopen, delete. Default: create. Example: create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey api_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
